payload.bio: Dylan is the co-founder and CEO of Overmind, where he and a small team show engineers the blast radius of every infrastructure change before it merges. Before Overmind, he spent seven years at Puppet leading professional services teams across EMEA, shipping the kind of automation engineers have to trust to sleep at night. He’s watched four waves of automation reshape software delivery, and AI is the first one to change the shape of the engineering role itself, which is why he can’t stop talking about it. Originally from Melbourne, he now lives in San Francisco and spends his weekends exploring California with his wife and puppy.
payload.name: Dylan Ratcliffe

result.name: Contributing with confidence: Capital One's open source contribution workflows

payload.abstract:
Organizations in highly regulated industries face strict regulatory requirements—and though many are interested in contributing to open source projects, they often require a private review process. GitHub recently released an open source tool called the Private Mirrors App, which Capital One is incorporating into a new OSS contribution portal.

Join Eric Sorenson, senior product manager, and Riley Kohler, software engineer in the Open Source Programs Office (OSPO) at Capital One, to learn more about these tools and how to create an open source contribution workflow tailored to your organization's needs.
payload.title: Contributing with confidence: Capital One's open source contribution workflows

payload.description: Start, build and ship full-stack apps on the platform built for agent experience (AX). AI makes it easy to generate code. The harder part comes next. Getting changes live. Keeping systems stable. Understanding what broke when something doesn’t behave as expected. That challenge grows as updates happen faster and more often. That’s the gap we’re closing. Netlify brings the whole development workflow into one platform. Start, ship, build, run, all in the same place. Builders and agents move from idea to production quickly, without losing context. We coined this agent experience (AX), a shared workflow where humans and AI agents work side by side, taking responsibility for shipping quality software. We bring together modern web frameworks, serverless functions, edge computing and managed Postgres in one platform. Leading AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI come built in. The result is an unmatched user experience for anyone who builds with AI. More than 14 million builders use Netlify, from solo developers and vibe coders to Fortune 100 companies and teams at Figma, Mattel, and Riot Games.

updates.text: Deploy Previews gave developers a URL to review each other's work. The preview in Agent Runners now does the same for someone describing what they want in plain language. It sits right next to your prompt, so you can ask for something, watch it appear, and say what to change next without switching tabs.
You can now file, track, and collaborate on support tickets without leaving the Netlify app. The Support Hub came out of our team building its own version of Zendesk with Netlify, on Netlify.
